mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stores WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stores WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND operation_status = #{operationStatus}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stores s INNER JOIN business_verifications bv ON bv.id = s.business_verification_id WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL AND bv.business_status_code = '01'

SELECT s.id AS store_id, s.user_id AS owner_user_id, s.store_name, s.business_registration_number, COALESCE(bv.business_status_name, bv.business_status_code, '미확인') AS business_status, s.operation_status, s.created_at FROM stores s LEFT JOIN business_verifications bv ON bv.id = s.business_verification_id WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
